description.text: This program is aiming to cultivate international talents with a systematical and comprehensive knowledge of computer technology including computer hardware, software and application. And the ability to conduct academic research. Graduates are capable of working in scientific research departments, education unit, enterprise, institution, computer hardware/software development and administrative department to engage in computer science teaching, science research and computer science and technology application. Main Courses: Circuit Theory, Analog Electronics Technique, Digital Logic, Numerical Analysis, Principles of Computer, Microcomputer Technique, Computer Systems Organization, Computer Network, High Level Language, Assembly Language, Data Structure, Operating System, etc.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Nanjing University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number&expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Academic transcript of high school5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: Applicant should hold high school graduation certificate with excellent performance and good health, and have valid foreign passport. Applicant should hold HSK level 3 certificate;
